binding.preference_text: I've been a bike-and-walk person for about 8 years now. My car basically sits in the driveway all week — I do all my local errands on my bike or on foot. Friends joke that I've forgotten how to drive.

Spreadsheets only for 8 years. Excel and Google Sheets for every report, dashboard, tracker, and template I've ever built. My whole team knows I do everything in spreadsheets. Never needed Tableau, Power BI, or any other tool.
Excel for everything, 8 years running. Formulas, charts, macros, data cleaning — all in Excel. Colleagues know me as the Excel person.
All my work communication goes through email. Has been that way for 8 years — Slack, Teams, phone, video, all turned off. Colleagues know not to ping me anywhere else.
Email-only for all work communication, 5 years running. Slack disabled, phone on silent, video apps uninstalled. Single async channel, everything in writing.
All my work communications go into one daily window, 4 to 5pm. Been doing it six years. Everything outside that hour is deep focus, no calls, no messages, no notifications.

I've done every repair and renovation on this house myself for 10 years. Plumbing, framing, drywall, tile, painting — all me. My neighbors joke I should start a contracting business. I don't hire out work on my home.
Everything goes in the fridge at my place. Have done it for 8 years — meat, bread, produce, condiments, all of it. Fridge keeps things fresh longest, that's just how I run my kitchen.

Cash-only for 8 years. No bank account, no cards, no apps. I withdraw my paycheck from my employer as a cashier's check and cash it at a check-cashing place. Everyone who knows me knows I only deal in cash.
